visual_review.conclusion: The right-hand corrections remain overcurled with thumb/ring/pinky contacts near the fronts. The guided image changes posture but is not accepted as natural performance.

conclusion: Contact-only and posture-guided corrections pass the local gates with all four requested held skin contacts. Guidance reduces reference deviation from 7.2424 to 3.7351, but the naturalness review fails. Both calibrated-depth treatments are rejected (2.1703 mm penetration, proxy self overlap, four unsupported anchors). This local solve cannot establish global infeasibility; broader contact/wrist planning remains necessary.
